[[Dextarr Dirtdigger]] is a collector, a type of [[NPC]] that exchanges [[Trophy|trophies]] for armor.

*{{skill icon|Signet of Rejuvenation}}

==Dialogue==
:''"[[Torg Bloodspine|Torg]] wasn't the only one captured by [[Pyre Fierceshot|Pyre]]'s Warband. I thought they spared me, but then [[Gron Fierceclaw|Gron]] made us investigate that passage. We barely escaped with the fur on our backs. If I don't come back with something it will be the end of me. I was told to collect 50 of Diessa Chalices. Help me collect them. I'll give you:"''

{{:Dextarr Dirtdigger/Collector armor}}

==Notes==
*Does not have the usual "[Collector]" suffix in his name.
*If talked to when a character has less than full health, he will follow the party, healing wounded allies.{{verify|Does he also heal foes like other neutral NPCs? E.g. Kurzick Priests and Luxon Priests.}} He does not cause unnecessary [[aggro]] and does not engage enemies.
